# PublicationFlow

PublicationFlow is online and desktop publishing workflow software for ad-heavy magazines, shoppers, directories and community publishers.

## Online edition

PublicationFlow Online runs in a browser. Its workspaces include ad bookings, multi-issue packages, customer records and advertising history, visual flatplans, artwork previews, invoices, payments, collections and printable reports. Online flatplans support moving ads and pages, page counts, unplaced-ad review and rule-assisted placement. Saved booking views provide configurable columns and filters. Reports include aging, agents, issue comparisons and customer history.

Online invoice sending requires the publication's configured mailbox. Card capture and charging require the publication's configured merchant services. Do not describe these as enabled for every demo visitor.

## Online and desktop setup

Browser-based bookings, customers, flatplans, billing and reports do not require working inside the Excel workbook. Existing desktop customers can connect supported issue, customer and payment data to an online account. Production InDesign file generation uses the desktop production workflow and accessible original artwork. Specialized desktop tools include directory production, Xero exports and artwork-reminder emails. The online workspace needs internet access; the desktop option also supports local/offline work.

Original artwork in connected local folders stays in those folders; reduced-size previews are shared online. Final desktop production needs access to the originals.

## Demo, pricing and contact

Start Free Trial links to https://publicationflow.com/contact/. After a successful submission, https://publicationflow.com/contact/thanks/ has an Open Your Free Trial button to https://publicationflow.com/demo/. No credit card or waiting for a reply is required for the online demo.

Published desktop plans are Starter at $100/month and Complete at $149/month, with a 30-day desktop trial. Contact PublicationFlow to confirm online account configuration and pricing.
